title: HtmlVar
responsibility: Renders the native var element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlVar.attributes
inputs.description: Native var attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlVar.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native var element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlVar
outputs.description: The actual native var element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
